email_body:
Hello Tom,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. I found your details on the Loetis about page and wanted to write to you directly, since your work centres on roads, drainage, sewer and water design.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

Loetis designs subdivisions from 2 lots to estates of more than 2,000 lots, along with road, drainage and sewer upgrades for councils, which is the kind of civil design work I want to learn on. My software experience is from study, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Would you be open to a short conversation about any graduate civil role at Loetis in Geelong?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: Your profile on the Loetis about page describes a focus on roads, drainage, sewer and water design, so I am writing to you directly. This is a speculative enquiry about a graduate civil engineer or civil designer role with Loetis in Geelong.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, documenting road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works, reviewing drawings, carrying out inspections and quality checks, and keeping site reports and material records.

Your subdivision, road reconstruction and drainage work is the kind of civil design I want to learn on. I am based in Melton VIC with a White Card, licence and transport, and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My software experience is from study rather than commercial production, so I would start at graduate level.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about any graduate opening at Loetis.
